notes.title: Ice cream Truck Demo 1.2.4.0 Changelog
notes.content:
Hello,

We've just released 1.2.4.0 version. Thanks to everyone who's given us detailed bug reports!

Here's a list of the changes:

[h2]Additions & Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Max can now run.
[*]The ice cream in the scoop can now be restored to the ice cream container with a right click.
[*]Add warning image when player can't open ESC tab.
[*]Fix save file polaroid pictures.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fix a bug slowing NPC dialog speed.
[/list]

notes.title: Ice Cream Truck: Now you can play a demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38575362/343aa76691ffeb24953356d3397c1c2bfdac28ff.png[/img]

Now, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1375040/Ice_Cream_Truck]Ice Cream Truck Demo[/url] has been released. In this free demo version, you can play up to <Tada Land>. Drive your truck to the new world Right Now!

[b]Ice Cream Truck[/b] is a game where the plot progresses by selling ice cream that brings about certain emotions in customers. From sad customers to angry or scared ones, even intolerable ones… Offer some ice cream to the many different customers that come to your truck. The plot will evolve according to the player’s choice. Within the different events, make the decision that is the most appealing. What is it that you consider the most important?

Demo 1.2.3 version
[list]
[*][b]Language:[/b] Korean, English
[*][b]OS:[/b] Windows
[/list]
